_comment: MCP tool servers TARS starts (Claude Desktop format + optional enabled/tools/tiers). Personal additions go in ~/.config/tars/mcp.json. Phase 3 adds the Firefox and desktop (AT-SPI) servers here.

firefox._note: needs Firefox started from the 'Firefox (TARS)' launcher (TARS starts it itself). Raw tools are hidden (tools: []); TARS's web_* tools wrap them with site rules and approvals. GECKODRIVER_CACHE_DIR: the npm geckodriver otherwise downloads into /tmp, which a reboot wipes (a truncated re-download broke the driver).
